business_problem: KDDI needed to eliminate data silos created by thousands of information sources and separate analytics products so it could improve governance, reduce integration cost, and analyze customer and network behavior more effectively.
solution_summary: KDDI replaced its previous data-management stack with a modern Oracle platform built on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Oracle Autonomous Database, and OCI Integration services. Data from numerous custom, on-premises, SaaS, and multicloud systems is consolidated into a data lake expected to exceed 300 TB, where Oracle Autonomous Database provides a single governed environment for aggregation and analysis. OCI Integration services and prebuilt adapters connect systems across AWS, Azure, OCI, and SaaS platforms such as Salesforce, giving KDDI low-latency interoperability without building one-off interfaces for each source. The consolidated platform supports customer-behavior analysis, network-usage insight, governance improvements, and broader REST API access from one stack. By standardizing both data management and integration on Oracle, KDDI reduced cost and complexity while giving business teams faster, more reliable insight for service and infrastructure decisions.

solution_components.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud foundation for KDDI's multicloud data-management and analytics platform.

solution_components.name: Oracle Autonomous Database
solution_components.role: Acts as the governed data platform for consolidating, managing, and analyzing very large datasets.

solution_components.name: OCI Integration services
solution_components.role: Connects custom, on-premises, SaaS, and multicloud data sources with prebuilt adapters and low-latency interoperability.

data_flow: Customer surveys, operational datasets, BSS/OSS records, and other source data are connected through OCI Integration services from custom, on-premises, SaaS, AWS, Azure, and OCI systems into Oracle Autonomous Database, where KDDI consolidates and analyzes the data for customer-behavior and network-planning insights.
business_outcome: KDDI built a connected data platform that improved governance, lowered operational costs and development time, and gave the telecom stronger analytics for customer behavior and network-investment planning across a 64-million-subscriber business.
